properties.global_prompt: A cinematic showcase featuring a purple and chrome humanoid robot with a glowing neural-network halo and an "H" chest emblem. The robot awakens in a dark futuristic forge, demonstrates its creative powers through holographic interfaces and energy manipulation, then presents ForgeHub directly to the camera before a heroic finale. Sleek sci-fi aesthetic, violet and purple lighting, photorealistic, atmospheric particles, dramatic cinematic shots.
properties.local_prompts: The purple robot's eyes flicker on in a dark futuristic forge, it slowly raises its head, violet holographic particles swirl around, dramatic rim lighting, slow push-in camera. Ambient: low electric hum, sparks crackling. No speech. | The robot walks to a holographic workbench, floating UI panels light up showing image grids and video timelines, it sweeps a hand across them, purple nebula background, medium shot. He says in a calm confident voice: "Welcome to ForgeHub — your AI creation studio." | Close-up on the robot's hands forging a glowing purple orb of energy, molten light and sparks forming images and video frames inside it, dark background, violet bokeh, cinematic macro. He says: "Images, videos, voices — all forged in one place." | The robot faces the camera directly, friendly talking head, gesturing naturally with one hand, clean dark studio background, soft purple rim light, medium close-up. He says in a warm enthusiastic voice: "Connect your workflows, pick a model, and create. From a single still to a full cinematic scene — ForgeHub handles the forge, you bring the vision." | Low-angle shot, the robot strikes a confident pose, chest emblem pulses bright, neural halo fully lit, light rays burst behind, epic cinematic framing. He says with emphasis: "ForgeHub — forge what's next." | Slow cinematic zoom out revealing robotic arms welding around a glowing ForgeHub logo emblem at center, sparks drifting down, purple circuitry glowing in background, screen gently fades. Atmospheric music rises. No speech.
